entries.name: Ignis Bolt
entries.lore: A needle of fire. It only flies where you point.
entries.hook: Fires searing bolts of flame toward your cursor.

entries.name: Twin Ember
entries.lore: A forked retort nozzle that splits one breath of sulfur into twin sparks.
entries.hook: Fires two angled embers toward your cursor.

entries.name: Phase Step
entries.lore: The vessel slips between worlds for a breath.
entries.hook: Dash swiftly forward, phasing harmlessly through foes and projectiles.

entries.name: Piercing Aether
entries.lore: A thin ray of stolen sky. Line them up or waste the breath.
entries.hook: Lances through every foe in a line, briefly steadying your stride.

entries.name: Prism Lance
entries.lore: Cut quartz fired at speed. On first bone, it refracts into three knives.
entries.hook: Fires an aether lance that fractures into three piercing shards on impact.

entries.name: Quicksilver Parry
entries.lore: Liquid silver turns rigid for half a heartbeat, flinging wrath back to its sender.
entries.hook: Raise a brief mirror ward that reflects bolts into 3 quicksilver shards and refunds cooldown on parry.

entries.name: Crucible Cull
entries.lore: A hammer of the Great Work, dropped where you will it.
entries.hook: Calls down a concentrated alchemical strike at the cursor after a brief delay.

entries.name: Mercurial Tempest
entries.lore: The Homunculus vents its core pressure in one blinding silver ring.
entries.hook: Erupts in an expanding tempest of quicksilver that hurls and slows surrounding foes.

entries.name: Censer Lob
entries.lore: Heavy glass, thrown in an arc. The air between you and the stain is empty.
entries.hook: Lobs a heavy censer over the horde that shatters on impact, scorching nearby foes.

entries.name: Incense Flail
entries.lore: Swung on a blackened brass chain until the ember bowl howls.
entries.hook: Sweeps a burning censer in a forward arc, battering back nearby dross.

entries.name: Brimstone Line
entries.lore: A seam of sulfur drawn across the yard. The small ones fear it.
entries.hook: Draws a burning seam of sulfur that slows lesser foes crossing it.

entries.name: Salt Sigil
entries.lore: Consecrated sea-salt cast at the cursor to fracture brittle husks.
entries.hook: Inscribes a salt glyph at the cursor that detonates after a short delay.

entries.name: Ash Step
entries.lore: Leave a husk of ash. The mites chase the ghost.
entries.hook: Dash to safety while leaving an ash effigy that lures lesser foes.

entries.name: Censure Bell
entries.lore: One toll of cracked bronze drives lesser dross to their knees.
entries.hook: Tolls a resonant ward that shatters enemy bolts, shoves foes back, and slows them in consecrated salt.

entries.name: Condemnation Tether
entries.lore: A chain for the proud. The small are ash before the iron locks.
entries.hook: Pierces and incinerates lesser foes to bind the first elite or boss struck with a searing chain.

entries.name: Penitent Pyre
entries.lore: He carries the kiln inside his ribs; when the vow breaks, the whole floor burns.
entries.hook: Unleashes a consecrated ring of fire that knocks back and scorches every nearby foe.

entries.name: Crucible Cleave
entries.lore: A notched iron paddle meant to skim molten dross—turned to bone instead.
entries.hook: Sweeps a wide incandescent cleave toward your cursor, staggering foes and deflecting incoming bolts.

entries.name: Cinder Flail
entries.lore: Three slag links whipped in a blistering circle around the wrist.
entries.hook: Lashes a broad cinder arc with wide reach and steady knockback.

entries.name: Slag Harpoon
entries.lore: Barbed crucible iron on a winch. None escape the kiln.
entries.hook: Hurls a hooked iron lance that yanks struck foes straight into melee range.

entries.name: Molten Brand
entries.lore: Carves a glowing seam of slag into the stone ahead.
entries.hook: Brands a blazing furrow across the floor that slows and sears foes.

entries.name: Furnace Rush
entries.lore: A shoulder-low bull charge fueled by bellows air.
entries.hook: Surge forward in an armored rush, phasing through danger.

entries.name: Iron Bulwark
entries.lore: Annealed plates clamp shut while white-hot rivets punish every blow.
entries.hook: Brace behind iron plates for heavy damage reduction and knockback immunity, unleashing a counter arc.

entries.name: Calcinatio Slam
entries.lore: Leap to the cursor and bring the whole crucible down on the flagstones.
entries.hook: Bounds toward the cursor and craters the floor, venting overheat while igniting and hurling foes.

entries.name: Kiln Overdrive
entries.lore: Uncorks the chest furnace in a desperate blast that mends cracked clay.
entries.hook: Detonates an intense furnace blast around you, restoring a portion of vitality.

unlock.label: Complete a working at Ascension Seal I or higher

entries.name: Argent Lance
entries.lore: Starlight distilled into quicksilver needles.
entries.hook: Fires swift bolts of argent aether toward your cursor.

entries.name: Starlight Dart
entries.lore: Fine celestial splinters loosed in breathless cadence.
entries.hook: Rapidly fires slender starlight darts with high velocity.

entries.name: Prism Refraction
entries.lore: One beam enters the crystal; three rays depart across the chamber.
entries.hook: Deploys a refracting prism beacon at your cursor that splits primary shots passing through it into 3 rays at ±18°.

entries.name: Lunar Orb
entries.lore: Twin pale lunar waves loosed straight from the Astromancer's hand along a dual silver arc.
entries.hook: Fires twin piercing lunar waves toward your cursor.

entries.name: Aether Blink
entries.lore: Fold the distance between two constellations.
entries.hook: Blink briskly through space with brief invulnerability.

entries.name: Celestial Swap
entries.lore: Trade places with a distant star-shadow and shatter the ground upon arrival.
entries.hook: Swap positions with your prism or a lesser foe toward the cursor, briefly stunning nearby enemies.

entries.name: Solar Convergence
entries.lore: Aligns every lens on the astrolabe to burn a single corridor clean.
entries.hook: Channels a focused solar beam toward your cursor, searing all foes in its path.

entries.name: Astral Collapse
entries.lore: Draws down a dying star onto the cursor.
entries.hook: Condenses a star-well at your cursor that implodes in an immense blast.

unlock.label: Shatter the Arch-Alchemist in the Prima Materia Core
